decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch in German machinery with likely long industrial sales cycles, the collaborative robot loading system is still an option with unresolved market potential and too little negative evidence to justify abandonment yet.

The dual-table loading system appears to be an early-stage, possibly niche automation offering, so despite somewhat weaker visibility the prudent real-options choice is to keep it on the market until customer uptake becomes clearer.

The industrial dispensing machine shows the strongest early signal through its dedicated product page and Red Dot award, making continued market presence the sensible choice while commercial value continues to unfold.
